steps.note: Open the single-stage create flow for the auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendor bid.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to place the bid and revision.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the auction's vendor pricing sheet.
Verify rank is hidden after the initial bid.
Submit one revision from the same vendor, replacing the initial bid.
Verify rank is shown after the revision.
